estimators.ratio: O/N, N/S and O/S: the ratio of two arms' means of one user-mode counter per process (or stress-ng's find rate), with a two-sample BCa 95% interval over the run's rounds
estimators.columns: per-arm columns are medians of the same rounds; the ratio column is not the quotient of the two median columns beside it
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim

provenance.diagnostic: front-end counters on the 1k find cell, outside METHODOLOGY.md's pre-registration
